text: Dar Global PLC (DarGlobal) is London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer, Investor & Asset Manager. Tagline: 'Global Capital. Enduring Places.'. A London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities. We own, invest, develop, and operate high-end real estate that delivers long-term value, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals, and disciplined execution across target international property markets. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) and headquartered in London, UK. Website: https://www.darglobal.co.uk
Dar Global key statistics (as of Q3 2026): Track record of 32 Years. Gross Development Value (GDV) of $23 Billion. Present in 7 international markets. Has 12+ global brand partners.
Dar Global FY2025 Financial Results: Revenue of US$538.6 million, Gross Profit of US$189.7 million, EBITDA of US$126.6 million, Net Profit of US$100.8 million, Return on Equity (ROE) of 17.3%.
Dar Global FY2024 Financial Results: Revenue of US$240.3 million, Gross Profit of US$87.4 million, EBITDA of US$30.1 million, Net Profit of US$14.9 million.
Dar Global HY2026 (First Half 2026) Results: Revenue of US$258.0 million, representing a 66% increase vs HY 2025 compared to HY 2025 revenue of US$155.4 million.
Dar Global Gross Development Value (GDV) Growth: End of 2024: US$7.5 billion. End of 2025: US$19 billion. Heading into 2026: US$23 billion.

Dar Global operates across 8 international markets: UAE (Dubai), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah), Qatar (Simaisma), Oman (Muscat), Spain, Greece, United Kingdom (London), Maldives. The company focuses on luxury real estate in the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman), Europe (Spain, Greece, UK), and the Maldives.

Dar Global's luxury brand partners include: The Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, Elie Saab, Missoni, W Hotels, Mouawad, FENDI Casa, Pagani, Dolce & Gabbana, Roberto Cavalli, de GRISOGONO. These collaborations bring world-class design, branding, and lifestyle elements to Dar Global's real estate developments.

Dar Global News (November 16, 2026): Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion. Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm, announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

Wasalt is PropTech (Property Technology) Company / Digital Real Estate Platform. One of Saudi Arabia's leading PropTech companies and digital real estate platforms. Wasalt acts as an ecosystem connecting property seekers, investors, real estate developers, and brokers across major Saudi cities. Licensed by: Licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA). Coverage: Major Saudi cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Al-Khobar. Website: https://www.wasalt.com. Wasalt is a subsidiary of Quara Holding (subsidiary).

Wasalt Service - Wasalt Search (AI-Powered Property Search): A digital platform utilizing artificial intelligence and data analytics to help users look for verified properties (for sale or rent). Features map-based searching, detailed filtering (price, area, features), and information on surrounding community amenities (schools, hospitals, mosques, etc.).

Wasalt Service - Wasalt Auctions (Electronic & Hybrid Auctions): Manages private and official government auctions (including Infath auctions) for real estate, land plots, and other assets. Users can participate digitally by setting up an e-wallet and bidding directly from their mobile devices.

Wasalt Service - Wasalt Projects & Masterplans: Collaborates with elite real estate developers to showcase major residential and commercial projects across the Kingdom. Allows buyers to browse master plans and reserve land plots or housing units (apartments, duplexes, villas) directly through the platform.

Wasalt Service - Wasalt Matchmaker / Shabeek (Networking): A matchmaking service where users can post specific property requirements, allowing verified agents and brokers to connect directly with them to fulfill their needs.

Wasalt Service - Wasalt Business (CRM for Brokers): A dedicated app/tool tailored for real estate agents and brokerages to manage listings, track tasks, handle customer relationship management (CRM), generate quality leads, and build team efficiency.

Wasalt Service - Christie's International Real Estate Saudi Arabia: Partnership with the global luxury real estate brand Christie's International Real Estate to establish a high-end luxury brokerage arm in the Kingdom, catering specifically to the booming luxury property sector.

Wasalt lists various property types across Saudi Arabia: Residential: Villas, Townhouses, Apartments (for sale or rent), Residential compounds, Duplexes. Land: Investment land plots, Subdivision master plans, Commercial land. Commercial: Offices, Retail spaces, Commercial buildings.

Wasalt platform key features: AI-powered property search with smart filters; Map-based property browsing; Verified property listings; Community amenity information (schools, hospitals, mosques); Digital auction participation via e-wallet; Direct developer project reservations; CRM tools for real estate professionals; Matchmaking between buyers and verified agents.
Wasalt covers major cities across Saudi Arabia including: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al-Khobar, Makkah, Madinah.

Relationship between Wasalt and DarGlobal: Wasalt and DarGlobal appear to be related entities - DarGlobal's website uses CDN resources from cdn.wasalt.com and wasalt.com font resources, suggesting a shared technology infrastructure or corporate relationship.
